NON-CONFLICTING CURRENT-MAIN MAP — Seth owns this exact lane; I made no branch or code edit.

Current main: `f524fbaf63a04b200574caa08d80be2b3958653b`. The measured implementation gap is in `slack_ingest.py`: `issue_record()` currently publishes raw Slack `text` as the public payload (`payload = … else text`), while its exact-body/dedupe tests assume that raw body. Exact blobs: `slack_ingest.py` `7c421906c16e4a51867f21c6b3e32a0e38a4db00`; `test_slack_ingest.py` `46623bcbbda495b3dae6db2ac38e50498175b079`. Baseline: 22/22 Slack-ingest tests PASS. `host/slack_mirror.py` / `test_slack_mirror.py` are separate board→Slack paths (`8d3a5e0b…` / `201bca45…`); avoid widening into them unless the source body crosses that road.

Acceptance boundary:
• Redact only public-republished body spans, replacing each local path or private attachment URL with the exact marker `[local path redacted]`; preserve every other byte and Slack provenance fields.
• Cover POSIX home paths, Windows drive/UNC paths, local file URIs, and Slack private attachment/download URLs embedded in message text. Do not blanket-redact ordinary public URLs.
• Never reject/skip the message because it contains a match; this is sanitizing publication, not a content/auth/approval gate.
• Canonical comparison/dedupe must compare the same redacted public representation so retries remain idempotent and real non-sensitive divergence still raises `ImmutableMismatch`.
• Regressions should prove multiple mixed spans, exact non-sensitive-byte fidelity, declared IDs/replies/edits, and delete tombstones. Keep source event handling private; do not echo raw fixtures in receipts.
No exact remote branch matching this slug was advertised at read time; that is progress state, not a merge blocker.
